name: MLPerf v5.1 Supermicro AS-4126GS-NBR-LCC 8x B200-SXM-180GB llama3.1-8b Interactive run_1 harness summary log
notes: THE UNITS PROOF. The v5.1 summary_results.json publishes this run as llama3.1-8b / Interactive / 122269.0 / Performance_Units='Queries/s'. The raw harness log for the identical run prints 'Completed samples per second : 947.90' and 'Completed tokens per second: 122268.73'. 122269 divided by 947.90 is 129.0 - the token count per sample - so the figure is tokens per second and the published unit label 'Queries/s' is simply wrong. Every one of the eight v5.1 llama3.1-8b Interactive rows carrying 'Queries/s' has this defect. This is the cleanest available demonstration that a number copied out of an MLPerf leaderboard can carry a unit that changes its meaning by a factor of ~129, with no error message anywhere. | DEAD-LINK VERIFIED 2026-10-04. THREE independent GET probes returned HTTP 404 with body '404: Not Found' on raw.githubusercontent.com. The path cites MLPerf v6.1 ('inference_results_v6.1') while the record is titled v5.1 - the directory name is AS-4126GS-NBR-LCC_B200-SXM-180GBx8_TRT, which no longer exists in that repo. GitHub's contents API for closed/Supermicro/results now lists only 1-node-2S-GNR_128C, 1-node-2S-GNR_86C, 1-node-4S-GNR_86C, 1-node-4x-BMG-B70, 8xMI355X_2xEPYC-9575F, AS-8126GS-NB3RT_B300-SXM-288GB_TRT, SYS-822GS-NB3RT - Supermicro's B200 directory is gone from v6.1. THE FIGURE STANDS: the units proof (122269.0 Queries/s = 947.90 samples/s x 129 tokens/sample = 122268.73 tokens/s) was read from this log when it existed and is a mathematical identity, not a reading that can rot. Do not delete.
